h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Proddatur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Proddatur

items.pText: Proddatur, in Kadapa district, is one of the busiest trading towns in Rayalaseema, known for its gold and cloth markets. Its schools, apartment buildings and private layouts are adding play areas, and the first piece most of them ask for is a swing. Swings come in more types than buyers expect, and choosing the right one depends on who will sit in it.

FunPlay Systems manufactures swings and other outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 790 km from Proddatur. We send it by road and our installation team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh installs it. Rayalaseema is hot and dry for most of the year, so we use galvanised steel frames and suggest shade for the seating. Send us your site size, the age group and photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

items.q: Which swing suits a society play area in Proddatur?
items.a: A mother child swing is popular because a parent can swing with a small child. A double swing works well when several older children use the area.

items.q: How much space does a swing need?
items.a: A clear safe play area in front of and behind the swing, plus space at the sides. We mark this on the layout drawing for each swing you choose.

items.q: Do you deliver to Proddatur and Kadapa district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Proddatur, Kadapa and nearby towns, and our team or a dealer installs the equipment.
